**v1.1.0: Setup sets Cheat Engine up for the speedhack.**
- **Cheat Engine speedhack** (a new, optional part in Setup.exe, never ticked for you; risky, since KingsIsle may notice). If Cheat Engine isn't installed, Setup downloads its installer from cheatengine.org, shows whose signature it carries, and opens it for you to click through. Decline the other programs it recommends; Setup never runs it silently, because a silent install takes those offers. Setup then puts the bot's script in Cheat Engine's autorun folder (Windows asks for admin once).
- **What the script does:** every time Cheat Engine starts, it attaches to Wizard101 by itself, and again after the game restarts. It never attaches over a process you opened yourself. The bot's two speed keys set the speed, read from your Settings, so you no longer set Cheat Engine's hotkeys or attach it by hand.
- **The bot starts Cheat Engine** (minimized) when it starts with the speedhack on, or when you switch the speedhack on in Settings. Setup can switch the setting on for you after asking.
- Without Setup's script, everything works as before. AutoFarmer\LIVE_CHECKS.txt step 5 says what to try.
- Also in this version: v1.0.3's fix for talking to NPCs with a smaller UI.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to anything below v1.1.0, including installs set up from the v0.6.1 and v0.6.2 zips (they show v1.0.1 and v1.0.2). One set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips shows v1.2.0 or v1.2.1 (one run from the code, v1.3.0) and has to be updated once by hand: close the bot, delete version.txt in its folder (usually %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Wiz-Maxxing), then open Wiz-Maxxing (or the tray's Check for updates) and say Yes. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. To set up Cheat Engine after updating, run Setup (Start menu: Wiz-Maxxing Setup) and tick "Cheat Engine speedhack". A copy run from the code: git pull.
